assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create a finished 1536x1024 internal mission-map illustration for CyberLearn. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and defines EXACT road layout/camera. Image 2 is ART STYLE reference only: match its restrained futuristic architectural illustration, warm glazed windows, navy graphite panels, tasteful cyan/violet accents, quiet secondary buildings, small courtyards and moderate detail density. Keep Image 1's winding road EXACTLY unchanged in shape, position, width and endpoints at every pixel; it must remain fully unobstructed, because interactive mission stops and avatar walking follow its traced centerline. Preserve overhead isometric camera, canvas dimensions and road margins. Replace the old repetitive giant sci-fi monoliths at the edges with charming futuristic district buildings of varied compact forms: cyan learning library at upper-left, small observatory upper-right, glazed computer lab middle-left, violet archive studio middle-right, engineering workspace bottom-right, quiet small residential annexes along bottom-left. Restrained low secondary buildings, a few trees and benches on pavement OUTSIDE the road, small coherent pedestrian plazas and side streets. Buildings sit around the route, NOT over it; don't fill all open space with decoration. This should feel like a neighborhood inside the reference city, not just towers pasted around a racetrack. Reduce harsh saturated purple glow, use detailed tactile architecture and a few amber windows. Replace broad purple road borders with slim cyan-lit curbs and dark slate paving, keep every bend exactly; no baked centerline dashes. Keep contrast quiet along center of road for runtime mission markers. No giant icons, floating cubes, arrows, holographic symbols, people, labels, text, numerals, UI or watermarks.
